content_sections.heading: About AIIMS Nagpur
content_sections.text: AIIMS Nagpur was established under the Pradhan Mantri Swasthya Suraksha Yojana (PMSSY) with the objective of improving regional imbalances in the availability of affordable and reliable tertiary healthcare services, and to augment facilities for quality medical education in the country. The Institute has been functioning since the 2018-19 session and is envisioned to develop into an institute with the highest standards of teaching, training and research. Through this AIIMS Nagpur Senior Resident Recruitment 2026 notification, the Executive Director invites applications from Indian Nationals for the post of Senior Resident as per the Residency Scheme of the Government of India.

content_sections.heading: AIIMS Nagpur Senior Resident Vacancy 2026: Department-wise Vacancy Details
content_sections.text: The table below gives the department-wise and category-wise vacancy breakup for all 72 Senior Resident posts, exactly as published in the official notification. Departments marked with an asterisk (*) are super-speciality disciplines with distinct essential qualifications (see the next section); the department marked with a hash (#) is Trauma & Emergency, which also has a separate qualification list. The notification states that in case no application is received under the EWS category, a UR candidate may be considered against that vacancy. All vacancies are provisional and subject to variation at the discretion of the Executive Director, AIIMS Nagpur.

content_sections.heading: AIIMS Nagpur Senior Resident Recruitment 2026 Eligibility Criteria & Qualification
content_sections.text: For general (non-super-speciality) departments, the essential qualification is a postgraduate Medical Degree (MD/MS) in the respective discipline from a recognised University/Institute. NMC/MCI/State Medical Council registration is mandatory before joining, if selected. For departments marked with an asterisk, the essential qualification is as given below; candidates holding a DM/M.Ch in the respective super-speciality discipline may also apply. For the Trauma & Emergency department, the accepted qualifications are: MD in Emergency Medicine, or MD in General Medicine, or MS in General Surgery, or MD in Anaesthesiology, or MD in Respiratory Medicine, or MS in Orthopaedics, or a recognised qualification equivalent thereto. Applicant must be an Indian National. Only candidates who have already been declared successful in their qualifying degree exam, and will complete their tenure for the same on or before the closing date of application, are eligible. If the result of the qualifying exam is declared after the closing date, the candidature stands automatically cancelled. Candidates should not have completed 3 years of Senior Residency under the Residency Scheme in any Government medical institution (regular, ad-hoc or contract basis); any Senior Residency already completed is reduced from the 3-year tenure being offered. Candidates already in Central/State Government/Semi-Government/Autonomous Institution service must submit a No Objection Certificate (NOC) from their employer at the time of interview. Candidates should not have been convicted by any Court of Law. Candidates wishing to apply for more than one post must apply separately for each post.

content_sections.heading: AIIMS Nagpur Senior Resident Recruitment 2026 Age Limit
content_sections.text: No age relaxation is available to SC/ST/OBC candidates applying against unreserved (UR) vacancies. Age is counted as completed years as on the closing date of the application. 4% of the total posts are horizontally reserved for Persons with Disability (PwD) with benchmark disability, as per Reservation Rules and RPWD Act/DoPT instructions.

content_sections.heading: AIIMS Nagpur Senior Resident Recruitment 2026 Application Fee
content_sections.text: The application fee is non-refundable and must be paid online through NEFT to the following bank account. The transaction reference number and date of transaction must be mentioned in the application form.

content_sections.heading: AIIMS Nagpur Senior Resident Recruitment 2026 Salary
content_sections.text: Selected Senior Residents will be placed at Level 11, Cell No. 01, as per the 7th Central Pay Commission (7th CPC) , which corresponds to a pay of Rs. 67,700/- per month, plus usual allowances including Non-Practising Allowance (NPA), if applicable. As per the terms and conditions, appointees are not entitled to Provident Fund, Pension, Gratuity, Medical Attendance Treatment, Seniority, Promotion, or other benefits admissible to regularly appointed Government servants.

content_sections.heading: AIIMS Nagpur Senior Resident Recruitment 2026 Selection Process
content_sections.text: Selection is made purely on the basis of an interview conducted at AIIMS Nagpur. Key points on the selection process, as given in the notification: The date of interview will be notified separately on the AIIMS Nagpur website. If a large number of applications are received, shortlisting for the interview will be done based on qualification, additional qualification, experience, etc., or through a written test. The interview may spill over to the next day; candidates should be prepared to be available on the following day if necessary. The decision of the Executive Director, AIIMS Nagpur, on selection is final and binding, and no representation will be entertained. The offer of appointment, when made, is provisional and subject to verification of educational and personal credentials by the competent authority. Appointment is also subject to the candidate being declared medically fit by a competent Medical Board. Names of shortlisted candidates will be displayed only on the institute website; no separate individual intimation will be sent.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for AIIMS Nagpur Senior Resident Recruitment 2026 (Apply Online)
content_sections.text: Pay the applicable application fee online via NEFT to the AIIMS Nagpur bank account detailed above. Fill the prescribed application form (Annexure I) in the format available on the AIIMS Nagpur website. Scan the payment receipt along with the application form and self-attested copies of all relevant certificates. Submit these documents online through the official Google Form: https://forms.gle/Di3JuZ9vzKQF7Nuh9 , on or before 17 September 2026, by 5:00 PM. Candidates who wish to apply for more than one post must submit a separate application for each post. On the scheduled date of interview, carry the filled-in application form (Annexure I) along with all original certificates and one set of self-attested photocopies. If original certificates are submitted with the parent institute, carry the original holding certificate instead. Candidates already employed in Government/Semi-Government/Autonomous bodies must submit a No Objection Certificate (NOC) from their employer at the time of interview. Incomplete applications, in any respect, will be summarily rejected.

content_sections.heading: Caste/Category Certificate Requirements
content_sections.text: Since the vacancies are advertised in financial year 2026-2027, only a valid OBC-NCL certificate issued during the period 01.04.2026 to 31.03.2027 will be considered valid. Certificates issued outside this period will not be accepted. The certificate must be in the format prescribed by DoP&T vide O.M. No. 36036/2/2013-Estt.(Res.) dated 30.05.2014, as further clarified by DoP&T OM No. 36036/2/2013-Estt(Res-I) dated 31.03.2016. The certificate must be valid for employment in Central Government Institutions, and the sub-caste must match entries in the Central List of OBC. The certificate must clearly show that the applicant does not belong to the Creamy Layer. EWS vacancies are as per DoPT OM No. 36039/1/2019-Estt (Res), dated 31.01.2019. Applications under EWS category require submission of an Income and Assets Certificate in the prescribed format, subject to verification by the issuing authority. The crucial date for this certificate is the closing date for receipt of application.

faq.question: Q1. What is AIIMS Nagpur Senior Resident Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: It is a recruitment notification (Advt. No. Admin-1/SR/26/04) issued by AIIMS Nagpur to fill 72 Senior Resident posts across 31 departments under the Government of India Residency Scheme.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are there in AIIMS Nagpur Senior Resident Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 72 vacancies in total: 23 UR, 21 OBC, 14 SC, 08 ST, and 06 EWS, spread across 31 departments.

faq.question: Q3. What is the last date to apply for AIIMS Nagpur Senior Resident Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The closing date to submit the application is 17 September 2026, by 5:00 PM.

faq.question: Q4. What is the qualification for AIIMS Nagpur Senior Resident Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: A postgraduate medical degree (MD/MS) in the relevant discipline from a recognised University/Institute is required for general departments; for super-speciality disciplines, specific MD/MS qualifications apply, and DM/M.Ch holders may also apply. NMC/MCI/State Medical Council registration is mandatory before joining.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for AIIMS Nagpur Senior Resident Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The upper age limit is 45 years as on the closing date, with relaxation of 5 years for SC/ST and 3 years for OBC candidates against reserved vacancies, and further relaxation for PwD candidates.

faq.question: Q6. What is the application fee for AIIMS Nagpur Senior Resident Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Rs. 500 for General/EWS/OBC candidates and Rs. 250 for SC/ST candidates, payable online via NEFT; the fee is non-refundable and exempted for PwD candidates.

faq.question: Q7. How can I apply online for AIIMS Nagpur Senior Resident Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Pay the fee online via NEFT, then submit the filled application form, fee payment receipt, and self-attested certificates through the official Google Form (https://forms.gle/Di3JuZ9vzKQF7Nuh9) on or before the closing date.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process for AIIMS Nagpur Senior Resident Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Selection is based on a Personal Interview at AIIMS Nagpur; if applications are numerous, candidates may first be shortlisted through qualification/experience review or a written test.
